entries.title: Job 34:1
segments: ¶Elihu further answered and said:

entries.title: Job 34:2
segments: "Hear my words, you wise [men]; Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.

entries.title: Job 34:3
segments: For the ear tests words As the palate tastes food.

entries.title: Job 34:4
segments: Let us choose justice for ourselves; Let us know among ourselves what [is] good.

entries.title: Job 34:5
segments: "For Job has said, 'I am righteous, But God has taken away my justice;

entries.title: Job 34:6
segments: Should I lie concerning my right? My wound [is] incurable, [though I am] without transgression.'

entries.title: Job 34:7
segments: What man [is] like Job, [Who] drinks scorn like water,

entries.title: Job 34:8
segments: Who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, And walks with wicked men?

entries.title: Job 34:9
segments: For he has said, 'It profits a man nothing That he should delight in God.'

entries.title: Job 34:10
segments: ¶"Therefore listen to me, you men of understanding: Far be it from God [to do] wickedness, And [from] the Almighty to [commit] iniquity.

entries.title: Job 34:11
segments: For He repays man [according to] his work, And makes man to find a reward according to [his] way.

entries.title: Job 34:12
segments: Surely God will never do wickedly, Nor will the Almighty pervert justice.

entries.title: Job 34:13
segments: Who gave Him charge over the earth? Or who appointed [Him over] the whole world?

entries.title: Job 34:14
segments: If He should set His heart on it, [If] He should gather to Himself His Spirit and His breath,

entries.title: Job 34:15
segments: All flesh would perish together, And man would return to dust.

entries.title: Job 34:16
segments: ¶"If [you have] understanding, hear this; listen to the sound of my words:

entries.title: Job 34:17
segments: Should one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn [Him who is] most just?

entries.title: Job 34:18
segments: [Is it fitting] to say to a king, '[You are] worthless,' [And] to nobles, '[You are] wicked'?

entries.title: Job 34:19
segments: Yet He is not partial to princes, Nor does He regard the rich more than the poor; For they [are] all the work of His hands.

entries.title: Job 34:20
segments: In a moment they die, in the middle of the night; The people are shaken and pass away; The mighty are taken away without a hand.

entries.title: Job 34:21
segments: "For His eyes [are] on the ways of man, And He sees all his steps.

entries.title: Job 34:22
segments: There is no darkness nor shadow of death Where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

entries.title: Job 34:23
segments: For He need not further consider a man, That he should go before God in judgment.

entries.title: Job 34:24
segments: He breaks in pieces mighty men without inquiry, And sets others in their place.

entries.title: Job 34:25
segments: Therefore he knows their works; He overthrows [them] in the night, And they are crushed.

entries.title: Job 34:26
segments: He strikes them as wicked [men] In the open sight of others,

entries.title: Job 34:27
segments: Because they turned back from Him, And would not consider any of His ways,

entries.title: Job 34:28
segments: So that they caused the cry of the poor to come to Him; For He hears the cry of the afflicted.

entries.title: Job 34:29
segments: When He gives quietness, who then can make trouble? And when He hides [His] face, who then can see Him, Whether [it is] against a nation or a man alone? -

entries.title: Job 34:30
segments: That the hypocrite should not reign, Lest the people be ensnared.

entries.title: Job 34:31
segments: ¶"For has [anyone] said to God, 'I have borne [chastening]; I will offend no more;

entries.title: Job 34:32
segments: Teach me [what] I do not see; If I have done iniquity, I will do no more'?

entries.title: Job 34:33
segments: Should He repay [it] according to your [terms, Just] because you disavow it? You must choose, and not I; Therefore speak what you know.

entries.title: Job 34:34
segments: "Men of understanding say to me, Wise men who listen to me:

entries.title: Job 34:35
segments: 'Job speaks without knowledge, His words [are] without wisdom.'

entries.title: Job 34:36
segments: Oh, that Job were tried to the utmost, Because [his] answers [are like] those of wicked men!

entries.title: Job 34:37
segments: For he adds rebellion to his sin; He claps [his hands] among us, And multiplies his words against God."
